name: footer-bold
title: Footer Bold
description: A tall white page footer. It opens with an invitation and a big underlined email on the left, address and social columns on the right, then a huge pale brand name above a thin baseline with copyright and a back-to-top control.
use: An agency or portfolio page needs a generous closing block with a contact email and a strong brand mark.
avoid: The wordmark, email and address are fixed, and the huge watermark currently spells the library's own name.
a11y: Links sit in a nav with a semantic address, but the Back to top control is a bare button with no handler, so it does nothing. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white full-height footer: a bold two-line invitation and large underlined email at top left, a Brooklyn address and social links in two small uppercase columns at top right. A very pale oversized wordmark fills the lower half above a thin rule and small copyright row.
behaves: Static: nothing moves on its own. The email and social links only change colour or grow an underline when hovered.
customise: The heading, email, address, socials, watermark text and copyright are all written in the file; colours and spacing need source edits.
weight: light: A static page of text and links with no scripts or animation.
demo: Email hello@example.com, 123 Creative Way in Brooklyn, and a UI-Layouts watermark.
issues: The Back to top button has no click handler and does not scroll anywhere.
The oversized watermark is so faint it reads as a smudge rather than a brand mark.
polishWhy: Clean Swiss-style spacing, but it is a plain footer and the watermark is barely legible.
